name: Damian Chabracki
role: Full-Stack Software Engineer • Founder @ DamReboot IT

domains.title: Critical Infrastructure
domains.text: At Proffico: **security by design** for **SCADA/HMI**-class telemetry and field apps for water infrastructure, built to **NIS2** standards: contract-first APIs with strict runtime validation, code reviews, unit tests, **WCAG** accessibility and performance tuning for large real-time data volumes.

domains.title: B2B & SaaS Products
domains.text: **Multi-tenancy by design:** a B2B platform and logistics marketplace in one `Turborepo` monorepo, built as a **modular monolith** with clean boundaries, client portal, admin panel, invoicing and Kanban automation, plus SEO-ready websites for SME clients.

domains.title: Frontend, Desktop & Mobile
domains.text: `React`, `Next.js` (hybrid **SSR / SSG**) and strict `TypeScript` with `Tailwind CSS`, **accessibility-first** (`WCAG 2.2 AA`). State with `TanStack Query`; desktop in `Electron`, field apps in `React Native`, real-time charts in `ECharts`, maps in `Mapbox GL`.

domains.title: Backend & Data Layer
domains.text: **API-first** backends with `NestJS` and `Node.js`: **state-machine-driven** workflows, a **double-entry ledger**, relational `SQL` (`PostgreSQL`) and `MongoDB` modeling via `Prisma`, `OpenAPI` contracts, `RBAC` enforced in the API layer and rate-limited public APIs.

domains.title: Cloud & DevOps
domains.text: **Shift-left delivery:** `GitHub Actions` run type checks, linting and tests (`Jest`, `Vitest`) before every deploy to `Microsoft Azure` or a `Linux VPS` (`Docker`, `Nginx`), with `Turborepo` monorepos and `Grafana` **observability**.

domains.title: Applied AI & ML
domains.text: `Python` ML (`Pandas`, `NumPy`) exposed through REST APIs: automated KYC identity-document verification and a real-time text-autocompletion NLP model with 95% prediction accuracy. Daily agentic engineering with `Claude Code CLI` and `Gemini`.

featured.title: Rikigo
text: **Business value:** marketplace for oversized cargo: customers set a price, carriers accept or bid, the platform handles payments and disputes.
**Under the hood:** `Turborepo` monorepo with `Next.js` apps and a pure-`TypeScript` core: order state machine and **double-entry ledger**.

featured.title: Wallet Manager
text: **Business value:** personal finance app for budget control: income and expenses by category, balance and spending charts on any device.
**Under the hood:** `React` + `Redux Toolkit` frontend, `Node.js` / `Express` API on `MongoDB` with `JWT` auth and `Swagger` docs. Team project.

featured.title: Pogotowie Glazurnicze
text: **Business value:** website for a renovation firm in Katowice: four service lines, a free-quote form and tap-to-call on every screen.
**Under the hood:** lightweight `Next.js` site with WCAG 2.2 AA tests and Lighthouse 100/100/100 for performance, SEO and accessibility.

featured.title: Czarymary Okulary
text: **Business value:** redesigned site of a Warsaw optical salon for children and adults: offer, news and directions in a few clicks.
**Under the hood:** `Next.js` with a subpage per offer, gallery and light/dark mode. Lighthouse 100 performance, 100 SEO, 97 accessibility.
